summary: Iteration 10 — Frontend-only verification of the Phase A+B+C UI-1 Delta rollout against the live prod backend. Login as cathy@example.com/testpass123 succeeded; Dorothy (Classification 4, BlueBerry Care) is the active participant. RENDER-STABILITY SWEEP: all 27 requested routes load without any red overlay, 'is not defined', or runtime error (verified body length + pageerror listener). §2 Price-caps copy PASS (gate copy on AIAccuracyBanner contains 'Department of Health (October 2025)', 'deferred indefinitely in May 2026', and 'Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission'; no future-tense '1 July 2026 cap' mention). §7 Aged Care Q&A PASS (route loads, overline reads 'AGED CARE Q&A', no 'Family Care Coordinator' string anywhere). §6 PARTIAL PASS — statement detail shows the 'Potential impact: $1,890.65' hero pill above the anomalies list and the anomaly card renders title + severity tint + detail, BUT 'Why was this flagged?' evidence bullets, the rule key tag, and the 'Notes for your records' section (testID statement-info-notes) did NOT render for the test statement (backend response likely missing evidence + informational_notes arrays — code path in /app/frontend/app/statements/[id].tsx lines 505 & 523 is conditional on those arrays being populated). §10b PRICE CHECKER UX could NOT be exercised end-to-end because Cathy's account is on the Free plan — the screen renders the 'Paid plan needed' ToolGate instead of the form. Code review of /app/frontend/app/tools/price-checker.tsx confirms all three tiles (You're charged / Indicative median / Indicative range with 'DoH Oct 2025'), 'per hour/trip/meal' unit hint, stream badge, and prefill pill row are correctly implemented behind the paywall. Statement Lifecycle PASS — Archive + Audit log buttons visible at bottom of /statements/{id}; ArchiveConfirmModal opens with full preview payload (period_label, filename, total, missing-period warning, Cancel + 'Archive statement' actions); /statements/{id}/audit-log renders the empty-state ('No events yet') cleanly; /statements/archived empty state renders; testID statements-archived-link pill is present on /statements. Dark mode PASS — toggle persists, WaylyHeader teal banner + Back chip survive on every sub-screen (verified /today, /settings/plan, /statements/{id}, /settings/appearance), no black-on-dark text. §19 DATE FORMAT — FAIL: only /notifications uses DD/MM/YYYY; every other screen with dates (/today, /statements, /alerts, /timeline, /tools, /settings/plan, statement detail header, audit log timestamps will when populated, etc.) still uses the legacy 'D Month YYYY' or 'Mon, D Mon' long-form output from src/lib/format.ts formatAUDate/formatAUWeekday and from raw toLocaleDateString in audit.tsx & Timeline.tsx. The new src/lib/formatDate.ts is wired into a handful of screens (notifications, archived, audit-log, documents, hospital, reports, family-wall main path, etc.) but the bulk of legacy callers still pull from src/lib/format.ts and have not been migrated.

ui_bugs.issue: Both helpers still render 'D Mon YYYY' (e.g. '30 June 2026') and 'Mon, D Mon' (e.g. 'Mon, 18 May'). Per §19 they must be replaced with formatDate from src/lib/formatDate.ts. Observed on /today ('30 June 2026'), /statements ('1 May 2026'), /alerts ('9 June 2026'), /timeline ('19 June 2026'), /tools ('1 Jul 2026'), /settings/plan ('Mon, 18 May'), statement detail (period header '30 June 2026'). Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/format.ts:25-38.

Lines 67-68 use d.toLocaleDateString('en-AU', { day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric' }) which produces '28 Jun 2026', not DD/MM/YYYY. Must be replaced with formatDate from src/lib/formatDate.ts.

Three call sites (lines 113, 138, 163) use formatAUDate which yields long-form 'D Mon YYYY'. Must migrate to formatDate. This is the Timeline used on /timeline screen — observed '19 June 2026' / '9 June 2026'.

amendments.tsx (line 266 inline en-AU toLocaleDateString + formatAUDate fallback), correspondence.tsx (line 82 formatAUDate), budget-alerts.tsx (line 233), ratings.tsx (line 220), at-hm.tsx (line 110), referrals.tsx (line 148), settings/profile.tsx (line 45), family-wall.tsx (line 498 fallback) — all still call the long-form helper. The DD/MM/YYYY contract is only honoured where formatDate was explicitly imported.

integration_issues.issue: The test statement (0cf2bdc7-eb28-438d-85c1-396c43af4229, period 1–30 June 2026) renders the 'Potential impact: $1,890.65' pill and anomaly title/severity correctly, BUT the 'Why was this flagged?' evidence bullets, the small rule-key tag, and the 'Notes for your records' (testID statement-info-notes) section do not render. The frontend code is correct (statements/[id].tsx lines 505, 523) — it's gated on `a.evidence?.length > 0` and `Array.isArray(stmt.informational_notes) && stmt.informational_notes.length > 0`. Either (a) the prod /api/statements/{id} response is not yet returning the evidence[] / informational_notes[] arrays from the §6 backend handoff, or (b) this particular statement legitimately has no evidence/notes. Needs verification with a statement that has populated arrays.

Could not exercise the result tiles + prefill pills because cathy@example.com is on the Free plan and /tools/price-checker shows the 'Paid plan needed' gate instead of the form. Static code review of /app/frontend/app/tools/price-checker.tsx confirms all §10b requirements (three tiles with 'You're charged / Indicative median / Indicative range', 'DoH Oct 2025' on the range tile, per-unit hint via result.unit, stream badge tinted by c.streams[result.stream], and testID='price-prefill-row' pill row). Recommend either (a) upgrading cathy to Solo/Family for the next test pass, or (b) using a different test account already on a paid plan.

rca_of_issue: §19 RCA — Two parallel date-format helpers exist: the legacy src/lib/format.ts (formatAUDate, formatAUWeekday — long-form 'D Mon YYYY' / 'Mon, D Mon') and the new src/lib/formatDate.ts (formatDate, formatDateTime, formatRelative — DD/MM/YYYY). The §19 delta only migrated a handful of screens to the new helper (notifications, archived, audit-log, documents, hospital, reports, family-wall primary path, plus admin screens). The bulk of legacy screens still import from format.ts and therefore emit long-form. Recommended fix: either (a) inside src/lib/format.ts rewrite formatAUDate to `return formatDate(input)` so every legacy caller picks up DD/MM/YYYY automatically, or (b) sweep all 'import { formatAUDate' lines across app/* and src/components/* and re-import formatDate. Option (a) is one-line, zero-risk.
